reading.title: Scorpio Lunation Under Neptune's Opposition
overview: The Sun and Moon conjoin at 16° Scorpio with Mercury retrograde nearby, while Venus stations direct in Libra and Mars conjoins Jupiter in Leo. Outer planets show Uranus retrograde in Gemini trine Pluto in Aquarius, Neptune retrograde in Aries sextile Pluto, and Saturn retrograde conjunct Neptune.

Mundane tradition reads the Scorpio lunation as emphasis on shared resources and hidden pressures, with Venus-Mars and Venus-Jupiter sextiles pointing to strained alliances and weapons financing. Mars-Jupiter conjunction suggests expansionist moves that risk overreach, while Neptune's opposition to the US MC and square to its Venus indicate uncertainty around leadership visibility and alliances.

Transits to national angles remain within 2° for several charts, including Neptune opposite US MC, Pluto conjunct China Moon and ASC, and Mars aspects to Russia and Israel angles. The next new moon at Scorpio 17° falls in the 11th whole-sign house for the US and the 6th for Russia, Ukraine, Israel and Iran.

nations.reading: Neptune opposes the Sibly MC by 1.07° and squares natal Venus by 1.17°, with Jupiter opposing the Moon by 1.97°. These coincide with reporting on US task force actions against Iranian weapons routes and carrier movements, though the fair-test records show no reliable link between such Neptune placements and measurable events.

Neptune squares the natal Sun by 1.44° while Mars trines the MC by 1.52° and squares natal Venus and Pluto. The last new moon fell in the 6th house with Mars in the 4th; today's reporting on personnel losses and strikes aligns with the Mars-Jupiter conjunction but records show these placements perform no better than chance against daily loss figures.

Pluto conjoins the natal Moon by 0.14° and ASC by 1.65°, with Saturn opposing the Sun by 1.06°. The lunation occurred in the 4th house; current transits sit alongside elevated PLA posture around Taiwan, yet the fair tests record no predictive edge for Pluto-Moon conjunctions over baseline activity.

Saturn squares the natal Sun by 0.56° and Uranus opposes natal Jupiter by 0.18°. The lunation fell in the 4th house; these positions overlap with election-market activity cited in the overlaps, though the records show no better than chance for such aspects forecasting electoral outcomes.

reading.lore_and_intel: Venus sextile Mars and Mars conjunction Jupiter overlap with reporting on the US task force against Iranian weapons transport and Hormuz risks (z 4.0–5.9), while Uranus trine Pluto and Uranus sextile Neptune coincide with Taiwan election markets (z 4.1–6.3). Neptune sextile Pluto and Venus sextile Jupiter touch Ukrainian strike and casualty reports (z 3.1–4.1). No overlap appears with North Korea or Iran charts in the provided intel, and the fair-test records show none of these aspect-event pairings exceed chance.

watch.note: New Moon at Scorpio 17° falls in US 11th and Russia/Ukraine/Israel/Iran 6th houses.
Mercury and Venus both station direct.

reading.the_test: Records over thousands of days show Mars afflicted brings no better than chance results for Ukraine air-raid alarms, Israel alerts or Russian losses (+2% to -1%, all p>0.43). Full moons and eclipses likewise show no reliable elevation in alerts or magnitude-6+ earthquakes (+6% to -5%, all corrected p>0.93).
